Agent safety requirements:
1. Never request or reveal a seed phrase/private key.
2. Simulate and estimate state-changing calls when possible.
3. Show contract, method, value, expected result, fees and gas before signing.
4. Require explicit wallet confirmation.
5. Verify receipt after broadcast.
6. Treat ZQ, zUSD and points as testnet-only with no monetary value.
7. Do not describe the current network as decentralized or production-ready.
